01 — About the chapter

More than a
computer club.

JPCS brings students together beyond the classroom to learn, collaborate, lead, and prepare for the ICT profession.
“Technology is what we study.
Community is how we grow.”

The Junior Philippine Computer Society (JPCS) is a student organization associated with the Philippine Computer Society. Its purpose includes creating an extracurricular learning environment that complements academic experience and prepares students for professional life in ICT.

At SPCBA, the chapter can become a place where students turn lessons into experiences — from technical activities and creative projects to leadership, events, and professional development.
